name: Jorson
role: Oselle's go-between, with the silver key pin
backstory: A wiry man in a plain coat who carries Oselle's silver key pin and a blade at the small of his back, Jorson brought her offers to Chadickith in session 1 and on day 9, sincere about the offer and ignorant of what was at stake.

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: has carried her offers to him twice
